kind: Independent static contract evidence and mapping policy; no account access or remote health-data test writes

health_connect_semantics.meaning: Each RestingHeartRateRecord represents a single instantaneous measurement; multiple different observations on one date are not inherently duplicate or contradictory records.
health_connect_semantics.source_date: Use the record's own time and explicit zoneOffset. A missing source offset remains rejected because a reliable source calendar date cannot be recovered from it.

verified_call_chain: The resting_heart_rate branch collects RestHrItem values with getRestHr() > 0 into v1.
The com.xiaomi.resting_heart_rate.instantaneous branch converts FitnessDataOpenItem through toRestHrItem, filters getRestHr() > 0 and adds to the same v1 list.
splitDailyReport calls ListExtKt.minOfOrDefault(v1, null, new dcd()).
classes12.dex Ldcd;.invoke casts RestHrItem and invokes HeartRateBiz.g(RestHrItem).
HeartRateBiz.g delegates to splitDailyReport$lambda$14, which returns RestHrItem.getRestHr().
classes10.dex ListExtKt.minOfOrDefault compares selected values with Comparable.compareTo, retains the smaller value, and returns the supplied default for an empty list.
The resulting nullable Integer is passed to the DailyHrReport constructor as restHr.
native_daily_report_rule.conclusion: The native daily report selects the lowest positive observed resting-heart-rate value. It does not average the observations or choose the latest one.

evidence: research-work/mifitness-access-static/feedback-daily-record-utils.smali: reprocessModelRecordIfNeed uses changeToDestZeroTimeOneDay(time, sourceOffset, 0), resets zoneOffsetInSec to zero and updates both model time and item timestamp

bridge_policy.selection: After explicit source filtering, revision resolution, value validation and source-date validation, group RHR observations by the native raw target calendar date and select their lowest actual observed RHR.
bridge_policy.same_values: Coalesce repeated equal observations and retain all source record keys.
bridge_policy.different_time_values: Select the lowest observed value and retain all contributing source record keys in the local journal. Emit WARNING RESTING_HEART_RATE_DAILY_MINIMUM_APPLIED so users can distinguish a selected daily value from all instantaneous records being copied separately.
bridge_policy.same_instant_contradiction: If distinct accepted source records have the same source epoch millisecond but different BPM within a date, reject that date with RESTING_HEART_RATE_DAY_COLLISION; do not move timestamps or silently pick a winner.
bridge_policy.same_source_revision_contradiction: Keep the existing CONFLICTING_SOURCE_REVISIONS rejection for incompatible contents at the same latest revision of the same source record. Do not substitute an older valid revision for a rejected latest revision.
limitations: The selected minimum covers the valid observations in the selected input, not necessarily a complete day's observations.
This is a compatible bridge mapping inferred from the native report and raw-date contracts; it does not establish Xiaomi's remote write acceptance, overwrite behavior or immediate App visibility.
Existing different cloud values remain governed by the import runner's conflict protection. This policy does not authorize replacing them.
No RHR is derived from ordinary heart-rate samples, and no average or fabricated value is created.
The original instantaneous records are preserved in Health Connect. A single Mi raw RHR date record cannot preserve all of their timestamps and values.
No sparse avg_rhr-only daily aggregate is uploaded by this change.

regression_cases: Three distinct-time observations with values 58, 52, 54 produce one raw date row with the observed value 52, complete local source provenance, a WARNING, and no source rejection; input order does not matter.
Repeated equal values on one date coalesce without a daily-minimum warning.
Conflicting same-instant values still reject their date while unrelated dates remain usable.
Twenty-seven synthetic observations across thirteen source calendar dates produce thirteen rows rather than rejecting normal different-time values.
The existing source-date, timezone-boundary and conflicting-latest-revision tests remain applicable.
